summary: Kerbside bay on Boggo Road beside heritage park; no homes, but busy transport precinct.
reasons: Backs onto park and walled gaol grounds
Plain kerb on busy through road

best_section.where: Kerbside bay on the north side of Boggo Road, at the ring below the walled park

drivers.seclusion: Nearest buildings are retail, Ecosciences and school buildings, none dwellings; park and walled grounds behind.
drivers.access_and_room: Open to the road with a few cars parked in the bay; room for one van, hatched markings just east.
drivers.traffic: Through road beside Boggo Road station and busway; steady daytime and commuter traffic.
drivers.convention: A few cars park here; no campervans or tents seen.

flags: Busy transport precinct, station and rail noise
Yellow hatched markings next to the bay
sun_shade: Open to midday sun; trees shade the north side in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Parking time limits or signs on site
Street lighting and night security patrols
